objects.name: Analytic 2289
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies network traffic to Industrial Control System (ICS) Application Programming Interface (API) ports such as 4840 used in the Open Platform Communications (OPC) Unified Architecture (UA) or vendor-specific API ports from source Internet Protocol (IP) addresses not in the approved application client list, where the traffic pattern is consistent with write/control method invocations rather than subscription/read traffic. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.
